---

`icon-platform-username` is the default display mode. Each link shows the platform's icon, the platform's name, and the account, so readers can see at a glance where their support goes.

## Configuration

```yaml
extensions:
  support-this:
    display: icon-platform-username  # the default, so this line is optional
    description: "Thank you for considering supporting this work!"
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: coatless
      ko_fi: coatless
      buy_me_a_coffee: coatless
filters: [support-this]
```

## Other formats

In RevealJS, Typst, Word, and PDF, each link starts with a symbol for the platform instead of its logo. PDF output leaves out the symbols, which LaTeX's default fonts can't display.

The other display modes are [Icon & Username](qsupport-this-display-icon-username.qmd), [Text](qsupport-this-display-text.qmd), and [Badges](qsupport-this-display-badge.qmd).
